_doc: Monotone ratchet for scripts/check-ontology-wired.mjs. Each counter is the number of ontology legs that are declared but not yet behaviour: `staged` schemes awaiting their wave, and `n/a` gate/tool/hook legs carrying a written reason. A counter may fall freely; a rise fails the gate. There is no --allow-increase flag — raising a number means hand-editing this file in the same PR as the row that needs it, so the new number lands in the diff beside its justification.
_measured: 2026-09-02, 21 schemes: 14 active and wired, 7 staged with dated expiries (MS wave 3; SRC wave 5; UC/TT/RB/FS/EP wave 8). CANON and E were corrected from staged to active once the gates that already enforced them were found — the first survey overstated how much of the ontology was ungoverned. Each wave lowers staged; none may raise it. | 2026-09-03 wave 2: naHook 16 -> 17 for the new ARC scheme. Raised by hand, as this file requires: an arc42 slot is prose under a heading, not a schema'd artifact, so post-edit-artifact-schema.mjs has nothing to validate at edit time and a hook would be ceremony. scripts/check-arc42-slots.mjs is the enforcement, wired on both tracks.
